name: Apple

ICT2 (new grad).dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — team-dependent coding plus domain depth
rounds: Onsite/virtual day of several back-to-back interviews with the team
extraTopics: Depth in the team’s domain (iOS/Swift, backend, systems, ML)

ICT3.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — team-dependent coding plus domain depth

ICT4 Senior.dsaDepth: Moderate — domain depth and design carry more weight
rounds: Long interview day with many team members (reports mention 6–8 sessions over about 6 hours)

ICT5 Staff.dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — technical mastery, leadership and past impact
rounds: Extended on-site loop with technical leads and cross-functional partners
extraTopics: Technical mastery in a specialised domain

rolesNotes: Apple keeps its process team-specific and the cited sources differ on ICT4 years and titles, so this is the loosest of the big-tech ladders. Round details are from candidate-facing guides, not Apple.
indiaNote: Fresher and early-career hiring is described as running through the ICT ladder (ICT2 to ICT5). Apple does not publish a fixed India fresher pay band, so treat any figures you see as reports, not official numbers.
